get.description: Optional auth; invalid token 401. Only ACTIVE listings of ACTIVE owners, excluding Block both directions. All query combinations checked; invalid price/unit/feed/cursor returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with query field details. Seeded national keyset, no immutable snapshot promise. No version precondition for read.

post.summary: Create Listing with atomic media manifest
post.description: ACTIVE session. Valid own ready/unexpired TEMP uploads, 1-5 images and <=1 video. Province active; no self-approved status/owner/cycle. Transaction creates Listing and attaches media, version=1. No expectedVersion for create; failed save leaves uploads TEMP. Response Location is API detail path. Incomplete storage manifest returns 409 MEDIA_NOT_READY; TEMP status alone does not prove readiness.

patch.description: ACTIVE owner only; others/absent/deleted 404. Body expectedVersion required; stale 409 LISTING_VERSION_CONFLICT. Existing Conversation requires confirmation or 409 LISTING_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED; type locked 409 LISTING_TYPE_LOCKED; accepted HIDDEN must reopen. Validate final merged price/unit, Province, manifest. One version increment, no implicit status/cycle/follow change. Notification integration remains planned. Unready asset returns 409 MEDIA_NOT_READY.

delete.description: ACTIVE owner, confirmDelete true and expectedVersion required; stale 409. Atomic terminal DELETED, no public media/detail, retains Conversation/proposal/snapshot. Owner retry on tombstone with current version returns 204, stale old version 409. Body required; no hard delete or restore.

patch.description: ACTIVE owner, expectedVersion required/stale 409. ACTIVE->HIDDEN pauses pending accept, keeps media/follows. HIDDEN->ACTIVE increments activeCycle; any ACCEPTED requires confirmReopenAfterAccepted or 409 LISTING_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED. Same-state no-op still checks version. DELETED terminal/404.

delete.summary: Remove own follow even if Listing is invisible

post.summary: Upload one validated TEMP Listing asset
post.description: ACTIVE session. Raw file input IMAGE JPG/PNG/WebP <=10485760 bytes or VIDEO MP4/WebM <=104857600 bytes with real duration >0 <=180s. Server inspects actual content, optimizes image and thumbnail. 201 only after private object variants ready; TTL15 minutes from reservation, sizeBytes is stored rendition size. No Listing/version yet. Invalid duration 400; invalid content 415; over input size 413. Video is validated by bounded FFprobe/FFmpeg processes on private staging; the stored video is unchanged. Missing, incompatible or timed-out validator returns 503 MEDIA_VIDEO_UNAVAILABLE; upload capacity returns 503 MEDIA_UPLOAD_BUSY. Validator accepts one video stream and at most one audio stream, no data/attachment streams, at most 40000000 pixels/frame. MP4 major brands isom/iso2/iso3/iso4/iso5/iso6/mp41/mp42/avc1/dash; WebM requires an actual EBML webm DocType, VP8/VP9/AV1 video and Vorbis/Opus audio. Unverifiable or unsupported streams return 415.

delete.description: ACTIVE uploader; foreign/unknown 404. TEMP->DELETING and outbox atomic; own DELETING/deleted 204; ATTACHED 409 MEDIA_ALREADY_ATTACHED. No Listing version precondition. Delete physical file after commit with retry, never claim current attachment.

get.description: Optional auth; invalid token 401. Apply same detail visibility including owner HIDDEN; asset must be ATTACHED on this Listing and not deleted. DELETED, TEMP, wrong Listing or denied Block/state returns 404. variant thumbnail/detail for IMAGE, original for VIDEO; omitted defaults detail IMAGE/original VIDEO. Unsupported variant returns 400. Single bytes Range for VIDEO only; invalid/multiple/unsatisfiable range 416. Not a Chat snapshot endpoint; no version precondition. IMAGE and VIDEO delivery implemented. Video supports a single byte range and If-Range without a validator falls back to the complete 200 response. Private bytes are streamed; Content-Range on 416 is bytes */size.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: Image thumbnail/detail, video original; default depends on media type.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Optional single bytes range for VIDEO; IMAGE does not support Range (416).

Reauthenticate.description: Exactly one usable method: password, verified-phone code plus challengeId, or linked Google credential plus challengeId. Invalid method combinations are rejected with 401.

ListingPrice.description: Positive integer VND Decimal(15,0), never JSON number, NaN or exponent.

MediaSizeBytes.description: Positive byte count serialized safely from BigInt; input limits checked separately.

ListingCursor.description: Opaque base64url JSON v1; strict scope/viewer/queryHash/sort/seed/asOf/keyset binding. See LISTING_MEDIA_DESIGN.md. Not an authorization credential. Discovery, public-user and followed cursors require timestamps and the derived postedWithin lower bound to be at least 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z for PostgreSQL parameter encoding; unsupported bounds return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR at query.after.

ListingMediaManifest.description: Full atomic final membership/order. All IDs owned and ready: retained ATTACHED on this Listing or unexpired TEMP. cover must be an image in imageIds; if omitted preserve old cover if retained, else first image. Null videoId removes video.

ListingCreate.description: Create ACTIVE Listing only with valid final media. Strict alternatives enforce type/price/unit. Text and media must pass server checks.
